caveat: Added 27 Oct 2026 after the frozen run (verdicts unchanged): about 30% of F6 (8-K 3.01) events stopped trading within days and were counted -100% as pre-registered, but most are MERGER CLOSINGS (3.01 filed with 2.01 / 3.03 / 5.01: holders were cashed out, not wiped out). In the 400-event sample at 20 sessions, events that kept trading still lagged the average stock by -5.3% (median -4.5%), so a real warning remains, but the frozen -33% / -41% sizes are inflated. flags-today marks likelyMergerClose; the lead should not send a SELL warning for those.
